body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> LG Electronics launched ‘BH100’, its brand-new ‘Super Multi Blue” Player during CES 2007. Launching in the United States during the first quarter of 2007, the dual-format high-definition disc player will be the first player on the market with the capability to play both next-generation disc formats according to the company.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Nikki Hwang, Daniel Sirh >
